record.one_liner: Ecommerce website builder whose Commerce APIs let developers read and write orders, products, inventory and transactions for a merchant site.
record.auth_notes: API key generated in the site's Developer API Keys settings (Commerce Advanced plan, own-site custom apps). OAuth 2.0 for third-party apps requires registering an OAuth client, which is reviewed and approved.
record.access_notes: critic: access paid_plan -> approval_required. API keys only work for a merchant's own site on Commerce Advanced, but the third-party developer path is OAuth: register an OAuth client (no plan fee, works with customers on any plan) which Squarespace reviews and approves.
record.api_notes: Commerce APIs cover orders, products, inventory, transactions, forms, store pages, webhooks and more; Read Only or Read and Write permission levels per API.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict blocked -> ready_with_review, blocker paid_plan -> app_review. Direct API keys need Commerce Advanced; OAuth client needs review and approval before use. Official remote MCP exists; Commerce tools need Squarespace sign-in (Domains tools need none).

evidence.quote: Depending on your development needs, you can use a generated API key or start the OAuth process with Squarespace to become a registered OAuth client.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.
Squarespace Extensions allow customers on any plan to optimize and expand their site in a few clicks.
Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions. REST endpoints, webhooks for order events, and signed payloads for safe server-to-server delivery.
The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server. There's nothing to install.
The Domains tools work for anyone, with no Squarespace account required.
Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.
